name: test-watcher
description: Runs the project's tests in a thread's worktree whenever files change, shows failures and output in the side panel, flags the thread while tests fail (until they pass or you clear it), sends failures to Claude, and wakes agents waiting for a run.

commands.name: run
commands.title: Run Tests Now
commands.description: Run the project's test command in the thread's worktree now, replacing a run in progress.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop Test Run
commands.description: Stop the test run in progress in the thread's worktree.

commands.name: set-command
commands.title: Set Test Command
commands.description: Set the command that runs the tests of the thread's project (run in the worktree with your login shell). An empty value goes back to the detected default.

args.name: command
args.description: The test command, e.g. "go test ./..." (empty: the detected default)

commands.name: send-failures
commands.title: Send Test Failures to Claude
commands.description: Send the failing tests of the thread's worktree (the latest failing run: the tests, the command and the last output lines) to Claude in the thread.

commands.name: clear-flag
commands.title: Clear Test Failure Flag
commands.description: Take the failing-tests flag off the thread. It stays off for the same failing tests; a different set of failures raises it again, and a passing run resets that.

commands.name: toggle-watch
commands.title: Toggle Watching for Test Changes
commands.description: Turn running the tests on every file change on or off for the thread.

wakes.name: tests-finished
wakes.title: Test run finished
wakes.description: A test run in the thread's worktree ended with a result (passed, failed or could not run). Subscribing makes the plugin watch the thread's worktree. The payload has the result, command, exit status, duration and failing tests.

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread whose test runs to wait for

args.name: result
args.description: Only runs with this result (default: every run)
